title: Salmon Cakes
description: Crisp, golden salmon cakes made from canned salmon, panko, herbs and lemon, pan-fried and served with a quick lemony dill sauce.

image.alt: Golden salmon cakes with a lemon wedge and sauce

steps.text: Flake the salmon into a bowl. Add the egg, mayonnaise, mustard, lemon zest, 1 tbsp lemon juice, green onions, half the dill, half the panko and the pepper, and mix gently.
Shape into {count 8} patties about {len 3/4 in} thick and press them into the rest of the panko. Chill for {time 20 min} if you have time; they’ll hold together better.
Heat the oil in the skillet over medium heat. Fry the cakes until deep golden and crisp, {time 3-4 min} per side.
Stir the sauce mayonnaise with the rest of the dill and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with the cakes and a green salad.

notes: Canned salmon with bones and skin works too; mash the soft bones in, they add calcium.
Shaped, uncooked cakes keep 1 day in the fridge.
